newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BONDS CLOSE LOWER IN TANDEM WITH BUNDS.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BONDS CLOSE LOWER IN TANDEM WITH BUNDS.

text.p: * Markka bonds follow overseas markets to weaker close in quiet
trade after sharp rise in yields on U.S. treasuries last Friday.
* 2006 bond yield ends about seven bps up at 5.89 percent,
spread over Bunds steady at 25 basis points.
* Eyes on German unemployment data due on Wednesday 1055/0755
* Markka flat vs mark, seen in 2.960-2.9850 range near term.
Recovers some losses vs booming dollar.
